name: anything-obsidian
description: MCP tools for Anything Obsidian (one RAG search across every vault workspace, raw vault reads and vault management) plus the vault-workflow skill. Default endpoint is a running any-obs install on this machine (loopback 21503); point the endpoint at a team server (its :21500/mcp plus a user token) to connect without installing any-obs.

mcp_url.title: any-obs MCP endpoint
mcp_url.description: Local install (default): http://127.0.0.1:21503/mcp — direct server: http://<server-host>:21500/mcp

mcp_token.title: Bearer token (direct server only)
mcp_token.description: Server user token for a direct server connection. Leave empty for a local install.
